posts.post_subject: How Do I Make A "Holographic Video" that I can play on iPhone?
posts.content_md:
Sorry. You are in the wrong forum. This forum is dealing with holography, a physical principle for recording 3D images,

based on the interference of light waves.

Your thing hasn't to do anything with holography, neither with 3D. 

It is only a half translucent mirror which reflects the light of the screen into the viewers eyes. Therefore it reflects a 2D image,

and 2D stays 2D. You should look in a forum for video editing.
